Nadean:
Woah! Aren't direct human beings a welcome relief? Only got one shot at something? One oportunity to save the world? Then stop fucking around and get Nadean over here, pronto. She'll call a spade a spade, slap you round the ears if she thinks it will help you, and generally sick the dogs onto any prick who is standing around doing nothing and/or trying to rip someone off. Know what I mean? 

In short, picture a hot Helen in cowboy boots and a red G-string. 
Amen.
Nadia: Nadia walks carefully, even on flat ground, but here’s a question: What comes first, the chicken or the egg? How is a young girl supposed to behave (and therefore evolve) under the weight and expectation of a name intended for a highly educated and demure 40 year old?  (Unless, of course, she is the happiest person in the Kingdom, in which case everything turned out to be perfect.)
Nadine: Her name is so ridiculous that she is exactly not what one might anticipate. Cooler than she sounds and definitely sexier, Nadine is unusually delicious.
Nadya: An organised, rigid and very shiny brand new silver briefcase.
Nae: Funny isn't it, how some names arrive from exactly the opposite of what they sound like? I mean, Nae, or 'No', is a word she hardly ever utters. In that regard they should have nicknamed her 'Yay', because Nae says yes to just about everything. It makes her incredibly powerful. She'll passionately kiss in public, she'll be first out the plane and she'll be in the face of a wrong-doer faster than anyone, God love her. If you're about to meet her, all we can suggest is that you go with it and hang on! Good luck!
Naila: Once upon a time it was suggested that Naila makes up the numbers in a completely inoffensive manner. We beg to differ. Naila leads very well, she is pestered only by those who refuse to try their best and last we heard she was off to her first week-long music festival. Which means when she gets back she’ll probably quit. A bit of time off will do her good, anyway.
Nakeisha: Nakeisha is one of the least superstitious people in the Kingdom: Is it real? Can I touch it? Are you sad or are you faking it? If the object, idea or philosophy in question doesn't fit into one or more of these categories then it is none of her business. She's a nightmare of a boss.
Nakia: Lucky they never called you Soni, or Simsung, eh? Anyway, Nakia uses organic soap and tries vegetarianism at least once every two years. In general, she is a clean-living breath of fresh air who doesn't have a nasty bone in her body. For instance, if someone else crashed into her car from behind and where it wasn't her fault at all, she couldn't help but say sorry. However, she's no push-over. If she witnessed an under-handed act she won't blow the whistle immediately, although it will sit with her for some time, making her frown constantly, which in turn makes those around her ask her what's wrong. THEN, she'll speak up.
Nakita: Nakita is a lovely, happy and engaging woman whose only major floor is that she doesn't always think through some of her decisions properly. Did you hear about the time she decided to go parachuting? She's scared of heights, of course, but not to be disuaded, off she went. Anyway, there she was, in the plane, strapped to her skydive instructor, when at 9000 feet and about 40 seconds from the drop-zone she realised she couldn't go through with it. During the hysterical fit which followed the pilot actually injured in the wrist, and everyone on board was fortunate to make it down safely. Nakita.
Nancy: Her name is as pure as the driven snow and behind this alibi she gets away with a huge variety of wonderful sins. Nancy, God bless you.
Naomi: Picture this: You’re walking home while carrying one of those cool-looking carry bags from an expensive fashion store. You didn’t buy that much and so the bag isn’t that full but because it’s a windy day it’s almost impossible to walk without the bag blowing all over the place, at times nearly carrying you off balance or getting caught behind your legs. This phenomenon is called the Naomi Effect, and she has a pointy nose.
Nardene: Is she a hell-raiser? Well, on her day, just about. Once she's warmed up and rolling, then yes, you could nearly say that she was. Nardene is her own woman though, and if that means pissing off the masses then so be it. It might equally mean the masses finish up adoring her all the more. For example, if she was on a party yacht with music, drinking and dancing and she suddenly got a craving for pizza, she would damn-near threaten the captain with death, as well as insight a general mutiny, if her wish wasn't granted. Then, later, after the shit-fight of finding a pizza shop that will deliver to a jetty has passed, even the captain is grateful he gave in. Nardene.
Naree: Naree isn't big on surprises and she doesn't like being poked.
Narelle: A wild boar that lives in the forest. She has big tusks, she grunts and, generally, she is a contented soul in her strange little world. Like Jodie, she’s only really dangerous when cornered.
Nat: Nat is as cool as shit, and she cruises through life with the ease and grace of the bow of a cruise ship slicing the blue, warm tropical waters of the Coral Sea. Nice work Nat.
Natalia: Natalia is a nice wholesome girl, but she freaks out if she spies so much as the hint of a hair in her armpits, an out-of-place hair on her eyebrows or crutch, and if she spotted a dark hair on her upper-lip there is a fair chance she would consider suicide.
Natalie: The sexy new Swiss Army knife that’s ready to stab, cut, unscrew, slice, grip, open, scale, magnify and abrade anything that needs it. Unfortunately, she has so many functions that she sometimes forgets what to use when. The last time I saw her she was trying to cut through a wire fence with a screwdriver.
Natasha: A gifted ice-speed skater who is fit, competitive and full of guile. She’ll share a joke with you before and after a race but just take notice; if you fall during the contest and forget to pull your fingers into a fist as you hit the ice, if you are in her way you can expect to lose at least a couple.
Nathalie: Nathalie is essentially identical to Natalie, except that she is slightly better at dealing with unexpected chaos.
Natika:
What the army is putting together now is a Special Forces Unit called, The Natika. They're an excellent under-cover unit. No, they don't train so hard that everyone has a six-pack and most of their success arrives as pure luck, if not a gut-feeling. Indeed, the only six-packs they are aware of are those in the fridge. But if you want a group of comrades in some shitty little Middle-Eastern café/bar to come out and save your life - and it might involve some blood, death and general mayhem - then you'd do well to have The Natika in the room. Some will be pretending to be drunk. Some will pretend to be dry-humping a local hooker in the corner. Another might be pretending to be asleep on the bar. 
Sure, they'll have a beer with you while they're on duty and you'll piss yourself at some of their jokes, but in a blue flash they'll come to the rescue. So, there's only one question you need answer from her:

Are you my friend or foe?
Navanne: Super cool and stylish, Navanne thinks before she speaks, thinks highly of her education and her life - as she should - and rarely dates plumbers. The only advice the universe would offer her is that, the 'dark side' can be fun!
Nayeli: Like a splendid introduction, be it to a thesis, a movie, a good book, an incredible meal or even a 5-day Himalayan trek, Nayeli is full of beginner's luck, hope, clean ambition and only-good outcomes. Dread, failure, sadness, physical stress and heartache all come much later, and probably with somebody else. She's quite good luck to have around.
Nazli:
Nasty?? Bullshit! Nazli is like a sexy little squirrel whose job in life is to stick her head around the corner, completely freak you out, kiss you on the lips and say, "Hah! Did I scare you?" Then she's gone again in a flash, to go and spook someone else. It might be her Middle Eastern heritage, but in a land where women are empowered and encouraged to become anything they want, she's blazing a trail of fun and saucy hilarity. Trouble is, she darts around so quickly she's impossible to keep up with. 
Q: Does the work? 

A: Don't be bloody stupid!
Nea: Are her parents Italian? Perhaps, but she’s definitely not usually blonde. Extremely punctual, Nea endeavours to live a highly organised and streamlined life and you can expect to incur a penalty if you deliberately (or accidentally) mess up her lounge room. We actually wonder if she works too much. If that’s the case, can some tremendous man/woman/lover/admirer please just sweep her up and whisk her away somewhere for a sexy, loving couple of weeks? That’d do her no end of good. Amen.
Neena: The travelling nanny. She's been everywhere. Each time she gets somewhere she mails us a beer coaster from the pub. (She avoids the Middle East because strong-minded female drinkers aren't exactly embraced with open arms.)
Neisha: The elegant and sexy Ibis bird who hits her target every time, and with the greatest of ease.
Neive: Neive is no lout and while she's never won a raffle or a lottery prize in her life, she'd be almost disappointed if she did because life for her is about tapping into the undercurrents that flow below all of us. They involve things like passion, and love, compassion and self-expression. Indeed, you could learn by watching how she goes about it.
Nelida: Is she the most distractible animal in the Kingdom? For example, she writes lots of letters to her friends, of which she has many, but the envelopes usually arrive at the destination empty.
Nell: Nell carries a rifle and pistol, she drinks liquor from the bottle, she wears a face mask and her horse can ride like the wind, which is handy when you consider that Nell is, The Loveable Outlaw!
Nelly: Nelly arrived here with the First Fleet and she’s just about fed-up of having to wear a triple-layered dress, long sleeves and a bonnet in the middle of the Australian summer. Irrespective of that disaster, she can drive a team of bullocks, build fences, deliver babies and she can manually milk even a disgruntled cow in her sleep.
Neola: Neola never talks gobbledegook and she is dedicated, both to her friends and to living her life. Indeed, she performs a rather specific function in the Kingdom in that she acts like a human can opener. Why people hide most of their deeper fears and hopes is beyond us, up here in the commentary box, but people like Neola are a wonderful antidote to those who are uncomfortable talking about such things. The only real hiccup is that when dating, she has this fascinating '100 day policy' – that’s right, she won’t go to bed with anyone until they’ve been seeing each other for 100 days. Talk about getting to the root of your desire! But, we love her and if you ever find yourself doing the same, be it platonically or otherwise, then 100 days is a mere trifle. Let us know how you go…
Nerida: Regardless – or perhaps, because – she carries a supremely divine personal aura, Nerida is trained in the classical arts and the classical airs.
Nerissa: Nerissa will balk and talk and look over the edge, and whinge a bit, then she'll go back and check her funds, maybe ring a friend, perhaps even ring her mum, but then, when all is said and done Nerissa will TAKE THE PLUNGE every time.  I don't know why she spends so much time inwardly debating it.
Nerroli: Yes, well, there's no question about Nerroli's capacity to get stuck in and get a job done, but does she wear the 'frown of responsibility' too often? As an extremely intelligent and investigative personality, Nerroli abhors laziness and dereliction of duty. If you're a man - or a woman these days - and you marry Nerroli, don't think for a moment you'll be able to hang up your boots and relax for the rest of your life. No way.
Ness: Ness is busy and she has a job to do. Maybe it’s motherhood, maybe it’s the business she’s involved in, but she’s never slack and she always feels like she needs a break. When did that last happen, I wonder?
Nessie: You open the door and there is Nessie, looking like she’s just stepped off a roller coaster. How she fits it all in and stays happy is a testament to her never-say-die attitude. She prioritises well and she needs to, such is the fullness of her life. Someone, please, hand her a drink or better yet, drag her off to that yoga class she’s been talking about for the past six months.
Neva: Another skilled hotel concierge. Sure, she’s shagged in most of the rooms but what better way to get to know the place? She thinks on her feet and moves quickly, so it wasn’t like she was ever going to get caught.
Neve: Cousin of the male Riley, Neve has it all 'going on', as they say. She's got a heart, she rarely does or says wrong by others, she's cute, she's talented, and she's not caught up in all this modern day ego crap.
Neveah: No, she's not a face cream you fool! She's a tame polar bear. As gentle and as humble as pie. She's very smart and for some magical reason, no one and nothing in her presence would dream of doing anything to anger or upset her.
Nevin: No, she's not Bevan and she's not Neville, she's Nevin. Interestingly, however, she does present with a nice blend of hard work and street-savvy nous, as well as the intellectual penchant for detail and proper planning. But why isn't she where she expect her to be?
Ngaire: Honestly, how they pronouce 'Nyree' from that I don't know. Anyway, Ngaire is a wonderful, flamboyant and in-your-face fast bowler in a sport called cricket. Have you heard of it? She rarely does-up her shirt, she tries to put every batsmen in hospital and rumour has it that she set a record for drinking beers on a flight from Brisbane to San Fransisco. No, they don't play cricket in the USA but she got on the wrong bloody plane and decided to make the most of it. These sorts of things happen to Ngaire all the time. Someone ought to make a TV documentary about her.
Niamh: Yes, more odd Irish spelling. This time it's pronounced ‘Neeve' and it has produced a funny, sarcastic, big-smiley, delightful lady who rocks your socks off.
Nic: Nic is an empowered woman who, apart from her generally gorgeous look, is full of true grit. Once she makes her mind up about something, there’s no turning back.
Nicaela: It's rained for 3 weeks solid. The visiting relatives are driving you insane and everyone is cooped up and going stir crazy. Then you have an epiphany: a jigsaw puzzle!! Sure enough, the 5000-piece ensemble of a big old sailing ship lies dormant in the cupboard where it's been for at least 15 years. With a surprising amount of excitement it's brought to the lounge room and so it begins. Six hours later, after what's been quite an enthralling and, at times, surprisingly funny day, the ship is nearing completion. Then, with about nine pieces left, a shocking discovery. "OH NO, IT'S A NICAELA!" someone shouts. And it's true - two pieces of the jigsaw puzzle are missing. Now you remember why it sat up in the cupboard for so long. Oh well, at least it's stopped raining. Amen.
Niccole: Like many before and after her, she detests her name being misspelt and, despite being an ostensibly good and intelligent person, this spills over into her life in the form of a peculiar kind of impatience.
Nichole: Yep, her name is spelt weird but don't tell her we ever said that. What it has done however is produce a very independent and intelligent woman. No, she takes no shit from anyone and as an event organiser you wont find anyone more capable. Not particularly loving of tents, bugs or cow manure, we don't suggest you take her camping. Indeed, let her take you around a few of her favourite city restaurants instead. She knows what she's talking about. She's careful who she loves because once she's in, she's in for good.
Nickers: To carry such as a blasé name can only mean that Nickers has a huge IQ and a determination to get things done. And so it is. Did I mention that she’s also a bit saucy?
Nicky: Nicky is similar to her more dashing cousin with the short nickname, except that she’s a little more humble, and a little more rural.
Nicola: Intense and solemn like an encyclopaedia in a library, Nicola means well but she has twisted ideas about men and about the world. With lots of unconditional love, however, she’ll be fine.
Nicole: In olden times, The Nicole was the name of a quiet prayer uttered by nuns all over the world every Friday night. They prayed that they had the strength to resist the desire to go out and socialise, and to meet boys, but thankfully times have moved on. Nicole’s conservative skin means there are certain behaviours which she will not tolerate in public, remembering of course that this applies only to Nicoles with no other nickname. As such, she is efficient in dealings, she is a fine leader and if she is having an affair you’d never know about it, god bless her.
Nicolette: A busy girl who owns a tobacconist shop.
Nieka:
Okay, now say her name with me, "Nieka, Nieka, Nieka……", and where does it take you? Nieka, Nieka...she nicks down into hard-to-get-to places, sometimes requiring a person to think coolly and very quickly, and to be very sure of themselves. Nieka, Nieka...fresh and zippy clean, her smile washes over you like pouring a cold bottle of soda water over your face in the middle of the desert. Nieka, Nieka...she takes responsibility for herself and others if need be. People love her and rightly so. 
And yes, she was born to keep our jet fighters in the air, although she would have succeeded at flight school had she tried.
Nien: Nien is so inoffensive that she puts people to sleep.
Nieve: She's cool. She's fun. And she ain’t caught up in all this crap that most of us seem to take so seriously.
Night:
Really? Mum and dad?....Did you think about calling her Lunchtime as well? Well, deary me, Night, let's hope you are the breezy, jaunty and carefree soul your folks clearly aren't. Are they goths who took too much acid? Anyway, enough about your parents....it seems you are doing alright, Night, and have dodged and weaved your way around the expectation of being a quiet, heavy personality. Indeed, you're kind of normal. 

(But it was close, phew!)
Nik: See Nic, although this one has a much higher probability of having blonde hair.
Nikaela: No, she's not in the military but she's the sort of girl who could hack it if she was, even thrive on it. Why? Because she likes to know where she stands, she gets a kick out of achieving goals that actually matter and, secretly, she enjoys being given direction, although she'd never admit to that publicly.
Nikeisha: Nikeisha is the name of a very expensive racing yacht. Yes, the rumours are true - she did capsize a few years back in the Volvo round the world classic, and yes, two of her crew drowned because they got tangled up in the mess of ropes and halyards that resulted from the mast snapping, but what do you do? This is ocean racing and it's not always safe. She's been mended, mind, with a new mast and we're hoping the skipper knows what she's doing, this time. Good luck!
Niki: Surprisingly, perhaps, Niki is adept at dealing with the finer details. Where some people will neglect/forget the small things (which often comprise the greatest parts of the whole) Niki will not. In that regard she takes her time with many tasks, only because she's not being slack. Niki is rarely in-your-face, but don't presume she hasn't got the nous and/or guts to follow her words with actions. Indeed, she's surprised more than one lover with her hidden passion!
Nikia: It's not that she's dim, you understand, it's just that she lacks common sense, and that's okay.  Many artistic geniuses down through history have. Is she an artistic genius, you ask? Well, technically no, but did you see her talk her way out of getting that speeding fine last night? It was pure brilliance, so maybe she is?....
Nikita: Mmmm, interesting. Put it this way, Nikita is an energetic young lass, she's cute and her shoes (when she's in her 'civvies') need to be able to move fast as well as look good. However, Nikita is shocking at taking orders and she is not the person you want in the control room, in the bunker, whose job it is to insert the key into the slot, flick the 'arm' switch and then hit the red 'launch' button. Sure, she's a nice girl, but nuclear armageddon is never far away if she's around. What? You think I'm kidding?...
Nikki:
90% of Nikki’s are blonde – it’s a fact of nature – and men adore them because they are attracted to all bright and shiny objects, and blonde hair reflects more light than most, but don’t be fooled by the cute name. Beneath Nikki’s sweet and sensual exterior is a core that is incredibly tough and flexible. 
(Oddly enough, occasionally it’s the reverse and we love her for it, either way.)
Nikki-Leigh: Nikki-Leigh pushes peoples’ buttons and therefore rarely goes unnoticed. Built to deliver the truth, and her idea of what should be happening, NL is confronting to many. Born of bogan parents she quickly rose above that household and became her own woman. Love or hate her, one must admire her uncompromising approach to life. She has no qualms about asking a fellow out on a date, or, indeed, for his hand in marriage.
NikNak: How can an immoveable object always be so happy and playful? We don't know but it's a fact. Nik Nak is so free and fluid in life that stress and down times simply can't (or very rarely) get a look-in. She gives dull scenarios (and people) about 8 minutes in which to sort themselves out otherwise she's out of there. Another lass who attracts men by the dozens.
Nina: With a star sign of a Leo or a Taurus, maybe Scorpio, Nina is a French secret agent. She’s an expert in hand to hand combat, speaks eleven languages, can dismantle a AK-47 in about three seconds flat and she currently holds the record for le bisou du matin – The Morning Kiss. (A race that involves climbing the steps of the Eiffel Tower to the main viewing platform and base-jumping from it.) And she stops any room that she walks into.
Niska: Small things are never worth getting upset over Niska. Not ever, and most concerns are. Yes, you are cute and boys like your bottom, but happiness is your responsibility.
Nitza: Her assessments of human behaviour, especially those of large groups, are usually pin-point. If she doesn't study law or politics or marketing at a university somewhere then for all we know she might be a Brazilian volley ball player. She's almost certainly got the legs (and by that we mean the height) for it!
Niya: Niya is a wonderful breath of fresh air who provides a calming and friendly influence.
Noela: There is a rumour that a New Zealand farmer once witnessed a few of his sheep lining up, side on, next to a cattle grid before crossing it by laying down and shunting their bodies over the grill until they got to the other side. So, who says that country creatures can't think laterally?
Noelene: A stock standard Australian kangaroo. Red or Grey, it doesn’t matter, and she wears an ambivalent smile on her face whether things have gone to shit or not. “Fuck, that’s inappropriate,” she’ll say, if they have. If she lives on the land her schedule looks something like this: flood, make lemonade, flood, make lemonade, flood, make lemonade, flood...you get the picture.
Noelle: Raunchy, zany and dangerous, not quite. Noelle is guarded and often quite secretive but never without cause. Fiercely independent and capable, Noelle is like an octopus in that she is unbelievably intelligent and she can blend perfectly into any background if a situation warrants it.
Nola:
Madison Square Garden, New York. There is one round left and the heavy weight championship of the world will be decided in the next 3 minutes. It's been a bruising encounter. The underdog slumps down in his seat in the corner and slugs some water. His dogged little trainer is up in his face in a flash.
"You think you're exhausted! How do you think he's feeling? What do you think we've been doing for the past six months, you and me? Look at me! LOOK AT ME!" she barks at him, nose to nose. The young boxer is almost dead on his feet. He lifts his weary, swollen gaze up to the trainer he loves so much.
"That's it," she says, grabbing him by both cheeks. "Now, you're gonna get out there with heart. You're giant, beating heart! And you're gonna finish this job! Do you hear me, boy?"
"Yes," he says quietly.
"I can't hear you!" Nola screams. "Say it louder!"
"YES!" he yells. "YES!!"
"That's my lad," Nola says, smiling. "Now go out there and bring it home, son."
The young boxer is listening. And he's ready. He stands and, staring at his opponent, he walks back out to the middle of the ring...
Nollene:
The farmer walks into the house, hat in hand, looking meek and sorry for himself.
“Luv, I’ve bogged the tractor again.”
His wife looks at him. “Is it next to that fence I told you not to get near?”
“...yes.”
“Jesus, Jim. When are you going to learn?”
“I won’t do it again luv.”
“Yeah, yeah. Are the keys still in it?”
“Yep.”
“Orright. Well you stay here, take the turkey out of the oven when that timer rings and I’ll be back with the tractor.”
“Thanks Nollene.”
The End.
Nona: A staunch defender of the family jewels and morals, Nona cant help but rise to the head of the family. She loves her kids and grandkids with a fierceness rarely seen, even though part of her mantra is encouraging her loved ones to stand on two feet and to stick up for what they believe in, which means dishing out 'tough love'. Is she romantic? Well, she'd probably tell you 'yes', but romance is difficult to slot into a rather hectic schedule.
Noni: The name given to the final product in a secretive game of pass the parcel. The question is, who is she? And, will she be worth the wait?
Nonie: Nonie likes playing a game that is some combination of the one involving her sister, above, with that of her other sister, below. In order to do this one assumes she is interesting, cluey, sexy and a mixture of all the good things. (And just as her sisters are, as a matter of fact).
Nonny: Nonny is a funny and irreverent soul who loves playing sexual dress-up games. She’s great company and good in a crisis.
Nora: Like manure for the garden, Nora is enriching in all but the most obvious of ways.
Norafiah: The outgoing fitness freak and body builder who stands out in a crowd. Gemini.
Noreen: Picture this: It’s just gone sunrise, mist fills the bottom of the valley and all is peaceful on the farm. Way back at the far end of the property there is a lone bull standing in a paddock. He has a stainless steel ring through his nose and he is a magnificent creature. In the still of the morning haze, he lifts up his great head, takes a long breath of air and then bellows out into the morning chill, “Nooooorreeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeen……??”
Nori-Jae: Highly competitive with a big ego, Nori-Jae will use all and any means available in order to get her way.
Nova: Nova works for a world famous motivational speaker and her job is to come on stage first and warm up the crowd. It takes guts, energy, a natural exhibitionistic streak and, most of all, a genuine love of people. She's got all that then some.
Nuria: Nuria never lags behind. Not ever. Indeed, by the time you catch up to her she's often found a better, quicker route to where you're headed. She has nimble fingers, works very well with small gadgets and she's a dynamite in the kitchen, although watching her won't make you relaxed at all.
Nyaa:
Two a’s, mum and dad? Are you for real? Anyway, it doesn’t really matter in this case. You two might be a bit twisted in the head, or at the very least lacking any kind of decent education, but you’ve done well. Why? Because Nyaa is calm, she has time, she has an enrapturing smile and she has the capacity to care for people more than nearly anyone you know. 
Not bad eh?
Nyah: The quiet and seductive hotel concierge who knows how to deal with problems. Of which there tend to be many...
Nyanda: Nyanda is lovely but she’s too polite to people who don't deserve it.
Nylah: Forget about the mini-furrows of concern on her brow because Nylah is genuine and agreeable. If anything she's only concerned about YOU, and what you are doing. She takes her time when making important decisions and impulsive displays of rash ostentation are not her. Her intelligence seems to scare off many men but they need not fear. She would benefit greatly from getting in the ocean and ditching her earthly concerns once in a while. Absolutely.
Nyree: The Nyree is the name of a pub about 3000 km inland, way out near the edge of the desert. Trackers, truckers, roustabouts and outback desert folk go there for beer and steak n’ chips.
Nyssa: Nyssa manages to get large tasks accomplished with a minimum of effort. How does she do this? It might be because she is super-quick at rifling through her address book and directing the right person to the right job. I'm not sure it's a skill that can be learned either. You've got it or you haven't and whatever the knack is, Nyssa has it in spades.
